intentional_adaptations.postinitPlugin: Registers Bliss (Ext) independently and applies the upstream compatibility gate.
intentional_adaptations._pathToTrack: Carries the sidecar's Windows path existence fix until it is present upstream.
intentional_adaptations._dstmMix: Owns the sidecar process, defers database refreshes during upstream analysis, and adds learned-matrix selection, play-count reranking, Last.fm similar-track guidance, blend handling, and experimental diagnostics.
intentional_adaptations._selectViaLastFm: Combines Last.fm recording and artist evidence with play-count influence over one shared candidate pool, applies a bounded deadline, and retains upstream artist-only behavior when the experimental signals are disabled.
intentional_adaptations._buildComparisonJson: Adds learnedblend overrides used by experimental comparison diagnostics.
